info.title: API.SH: Casas Bahia
info.description: The Casas Bahia API from API.SH: public Casas Bahia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Search suggestions as the store's search box shows them for what was typed, each with its results link; without `query`, the store's most searched terms.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/casasbahia-autocomplete

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The start of a search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The store's department menu: groups (Tecnologia e Eletrônicos, Casa e Decoração…) with their categories, each with its id (use it in /casasbahia/v1/category) and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/casasbahia-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of one Casas Bahia category, 20 a page, with the same fields, facets, filters and sorts as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/casasbahia-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A category id such as 38 or 38_326 (ids from /casasbahia/v1/categories or the `facets` of a listing), or a casasbahia.com.br/c/… link.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet values from `facets` (their `value`), comma-separated; several values are combined (e.g. marca-m459,preco-1000to9999,avaliacao-r5).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in BRL.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in BRL.

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Only this marketplace seller's offers (a seller id from a product's `sellers`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), popularity, price_asc, price_desc, best_selling.

parameters.name: prices
parameters.description: false to leave out prices (faster); default true.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first (500 at most). Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Casas Bahia product by SKU: name, brand, price, list price, discount, Pix/boleto price, installment text, full installment tables per payment type (card, store credit, Casas Bahia card) with interest, every seller's offer (price, stock, featured seller), availability, rating with breakdown and recommendation rate, description (HTML), specification groups, highlights, categories, variants (colour/size grid) with each variant's price and stock, images, videos and manuals. With `cep`, prices and availability for that postal code.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/casasbahia-product

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: A SKU id (the number after /p/ in a product link) or a casasbahia.com.br product link.

parameters.name: cep
parameters.description: Brazilian postal code (8 digits) for regional price and availability.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Casas Bahia (casasbahia.com.br, Brazil) product search, 20 a page. Each item: product id, SKU, name, link, brand, price, list price and discount, Pix/boleto price when lower, installment text and best plans (card, store credit, Casas Bahia card), availability, seller id, rating and review count, sponsored flag, category path and images. `facets` lists the store's filters for the query (category, price ranges, seller, discount, brand, rating and product features such as memory, colour or screen size) with values and counts: pass a value in `filters`. Also returns the total, the related searches and the price range. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/casasbahia-search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keywords (Portuguese works best).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Limit to a category: an id such as 13 or 38_326 (from /casasbahia/v1/categories or `facets`).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet values from `facets` (their `value`), comma-separated; several values are combined (e.g. marca-m459,preco-1000to9999,avaliacao-r5).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in BRL.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in BRL.

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Only this marketplace seller's offers (a seller id from a product's `sellers`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), popularity, price_asc, price_desc, best_selling.

parameters.name: prices
parameters.description: false to leave out prices (faster); default true.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first (500 at most). Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Delivery options for a Casas Bahia product to a Brazilian postal code (CEP): each option's name, price in BRL, delivery time in days and estimated delivery date. The quote is for the featured seller unless `seller_id` names another seller of the product.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/casasbahia-shipping

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: A SKU id or product link.

parameters.name: cep
parameters.description: Brazilian postal code, 8 digits.

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Quote this seller's offer (a seller id from the product's `sellers`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: price (default) or deadline.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
